accepted_gates.name: Remaining target-profile integer semantics and indirect flow
Target-profile loader, memory and Win32 ABI/import boundary

interpretation: The unchanged roadmap first seven gates for the documented target profile. Not a measured fraction of total unknown engineering work, instruction universe, gameplay or Windows compatibility.
limitations: E3 binaries/assets/generated game code are not used on CI. Real target startup and real-target FP corpus are local Linux results only.
Native x87/SIMD oracles use original dual-mode FP instruction bytes on x64 hardware, not native-i386 whole-game execution.
Static image TLS, SEH/exception delivery, guest thread scheduling, arbitrary guest DLL loading, GUI/graphics/audio/input/networking and gameplay are not accepted.
Finite randomized/boundary tests do not prove all possible guest instruction states.
Original Windows PE32-vs-generated-x64 comparison is an author-written 15-API synthetic program, not the E3 game.

comparison_scope.integer: Eight GPRs, EIP, defined status flags, complete 64 KiB stack.
comparison_scope.floating: Defined x87/SIMD data and control/status; host FIP/FCS/FOP/FDP/FDS and empty-register payloads excluded. Guest environment has separate exact-value tests.
